newsitem.title: USA: Calif. association of counties elects new officers.
newsitem.headline: Calif. association of counties elects new officers.

text.p: San Luis Obispo County, Calif., Supervisor Harry Ovitt has been elected president of the California State Association of Counties, the association said in a statement.
In addition, El Dorado County Supervisor John Upton was elected first vice president, and San Bernardino County Supervisor Jerry Eaves was tapped as second vice president.
Ovitt will represent suburban counties, while Upton and Eaves will represent rural and urban counties, respectively, the association said
The association represents California's 58 counties before the state Legislature and U.S. Congress.
